frontend.scope: Actual React/CSS/production CSP; simulated IPC, metadata and device state only; no Windows/audio/user acceptance
checks: Default four instruments use 8 management buttons; context/transport bounded at 1024/1280/1399/1400/1600 CSS px
Instrument menus: arrows/Home/End/Enter, focus restore, hide and recover instrument
Device configuration moved into dialog; live remains actionable and REC disables changing the source
One chosen source/region/output detail; selection never opens or plays; explicit inspect/export binds the selected version; output actions and focus preserved
Missing external asset has exactly one relocate action, with other management commands still reachable
Report sections preserve draft, chosen report and event page; four graph/format outputs work under product CSP; stale prepared graph cannot save after a source switch
Settings categories preserve theme/behavior drafts, close restores saved theme, apply persists explicit choices, no duplicate wave-gain editor, About matches package version
Reference empty state guides selection; offsets/ranges are advanced, folding them preserves the configured value
3D camera selection, advanced view settings, one visible shared time-window editor, standalone/maximized access, parameter Space never starts playback
One main analysis progress plus compact local states; capture/file faults remain independently visible with source identity; custom targets expand on demand
An all-disabled menu remains keyboard dismissible; Escape closes it without stopping REC

library.scope: Actual React renderer, production CSP, simulated IPC/devices/metadata only; no native/Windows/disk/audio acceptance
checks: Single click selects only; wide sidebar coexists with workbench; 50 mounted rows
Inspect stays paused; play/pause uses real returned context and preserves selection/cursor
Rapid A→B supersedes pending autoplay; only newest source is started
Export dialog isolates sidebar focus and returns focus to invoking row
Closing/reopening retains query, selected row, page and scroll
Locate current crosses pages and explicitly clears hiding filters
Import category uses existing source path; unreadable/estimated/unknown quality remain visible
Row audition preserves an explicitly loaded alternate export instead of reopening preferred source
Rename input suppresses global R/Space; Escape cancels form; row End and keyboard context menu keep local focus
Failed opening stays visible inside the drawer, sends no play and can be dismissed
REC leaves list browsable and disables audition
50/500/5000 metadata items keep mounted rows bounded at 50
Narrow drawer isolates background, traps focus, Escape closes and restores trigger (simulated 150% raster scale)
